name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Calls expense-api for all expense, category, limit, and totals data.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs a household member in via Thunder SSO and carries their token on every expense-api call.

description: React SPA where either household member signs in, logs an expense in whatever currency they paid, browses and edits the shared expense list, and views daily/weekly/monthly and per-category totals (in USD) with a visual indicator when a category is near or over its limit. Manages categories and their limits. Holds no business logic and no secrets — everything is fetched from expense-api.
